Description

2005 Topps Chrome is a 472-card set released in two series. The first 234 cards were released in January, 2005, while the final 238 cards were issued as part of Series Two in May. 32 cards (14 in S1, and 18 in S2) make up an Autographed First-Year Player subset -- the most prominent being Justin Verlander. This product marked the debut of the one-of-one SuperFractors.

Series Two Hobby boxes were packaged in Finest-style mini boxes.

Distribution

Series One Hobby, Series One retail, and Series Two retail: 20 packs per box, four cards per pack (MSRP: $3). Eight boxes per case.

Series Two Hobby: Two, ten-pack miniboxes per box, four cards per pack (MSRP: $3).

Parallels

All 440 unautographed base cards are available in the following Refractor parallels.

  • Refractor
  • Black Refractor (serial-numbered to 225 copies)
  • Red X-Fractor (serial-numbered to 25 copies)
  • Gold SuperFractor (one-of-one)
  • Printing Plate (set of four for each card; Hobby only)

Autographed First-Year Player Refractors

All 32 Autographed First-Year Player cards are available in the following Refractor parallels.

  • Refractor (serial-numbered to 500 copies)
  • Black Refractor (serial-numbered to 200 copies)
  • Red X-Fractor (serial-numbered to 25 copies)
  • Gold SuperFractor (one-of-one; Series Two only)
  • Printing Plate (set of four for each card; Hobby only)

Inserts

A-Rod Throwbacks

This four-card set, inserted into Series Two packs, features renditions of what Alex Rodriguez's Topps Chrome cards would have been like had they been released in the early part of his career. Despite making his Major League debut in 1994, Rodriguez did not appear, due to licensing issues, on a Topps card until 1998.

Of course, the Topps Chrome brand did not exist until 1996, so the 1994 and 1995 cards are speculative.

Each card is also available in the following parallels.

  • Refractor
  • Black Refractor (serial-numbered to 225 copies)
  • Red X-Fractor (serial-numbered to 25 copies)
  • Gold SuperFractor (one-of-one)
  • 1 Alex Rodriguez 1994
  • 2 Alex Rodriguez 1995
  • 3 Alex Rodriguez 1996
  • 4 Alex Rodriguez 1997

NOTE: All Autographs (with the exception of the Autographed First Year Player base set cards) and Game-Used cards are exclusive to Series One packs.
